overview.title: Overview
overview.openHarnessHint: Opens the harness web UI in your browser.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.searchEmpty: Search the market to discover plugins.
plugins.marketEmpty: The curated list is empty. Search the market to discover plugins.

settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Name
settings.protectedProfile: The web profile is managed by the harness and cannot be removed.
settings.deepseekRoute: The built-in DeepSeek route; id is fixed.
settings.apiKeyEnvHint: The environment variable that holds the secret; the key itself is never stored by DeepMate.
settings.noSnapshots: No snapshots yet. Export your current setup to make it portable.
settings.autoStartHint: Launch DeepMate in the tray when you sign in.
settings.closeToTrayHint: Closing the window hides DeepMate to the tray instead of quitting.
settings.updatesHint: Check for new DeepMate releases automatically.
settings.notificationsHint: Notify when an automatic check finds a new release.
settings.ownSettingsHint: Export your preferences to a portable file, or apply one from another machine.
settings.deleteSnapshotConfirmBody: This permanently removes the snapshot "{{name}}". This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteProfileConfirmBody: This removes the profile "{{name}}" and its plugins. This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteProviderConfirmBody: This removes the provider "{{name}}" and its models. This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteModelConfirmBody: This removes the model "{{name}}". This cannot be undone.
settings.importSnapshotConfirmBody: This overwrites the current profiles, providers and models with the snapshot "{{name}}".
settings.importConfigConfirmBody: This overwrites the current DeepMate preferences with the imported file.
settings.aboutDescription: A lightweight companion and control plane for AI harnesses. DeepMate manages the harness; the harness does the work.
